products.name: Gordon AI
products.description: Unified cyber-resilience console spanning SOC monitoring, VAPT, brand intelligence, dark web monitoring, GRC, third-party risk, workforce risk, and cyber risk scoring. 12 modules across Monitor, Assess, Mitigate, Insure.

products.name: RELIQ
products.description: Proprietary cyber risk quantification model that ties live security telemetry to underwriting; translates cyber risk into financial language with scenario-based assessment and probable loss estimation.

products.name: Dranta
products.description: DPDPA-driven privacy governance and consent management solution; includes consent collection, data deletion requests, cookie scanning, 22 Indian-language translations.

products.name: Mitigata Console
products.description: Automates detection, investigation, and response; streamlines workflows for six-hour incident reporting window and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Scan by Mitigata
products.description: Security scanning tool referenced in product portfolio.

people.name: Pankaj Mitra
people.title: Partner at Bessemer Venture Partners
